title: Vibrantix Defect
description: One entry in a data/defects/<slug>/<severity>.json defect array. Converted from a QA_Tracker/*_QA_LIVE_TRACKER.md live defect registry or QA_Tracker/CLOUD_POSTURE_BUGS_FOUND.csv — see sourceFile.

id.description: Original defect ID exactly as authored in the source tracker (e.g. 'EM-001', 'RR-014', 'CD-002'). For the Cloud Posture CSV (which has no native ID, only a row number), a sequential 'CP-NNN' ID was synthesized during conversion.

module.description: Module slug — must match the containing folder name in data/defects/ and a slug in data/defects/manifest.json. Reuses the existing Modules-system slug for the same feature.

title.description: Short summary of the defect. For source trackers whose 'Title' column is itself a long description (e.g. Risk Register, Tenant Isolation), this holds that full text verbatim.

severity.description: Normalized from whatever severity/priority column/format the source used (e.g. 'P0 / Critical' -> Critical, 'P1 High' -> High). Also the category value for this record — matches the containing filename (without .json).

status.description: Normalized from the source tracker's own status legend/symbols (e.g. 🔴 OPEN, 🟢 FIXED, 🔁 REGRESSED, 🟡 IN_PROGRESS, 🆕 NEW, ⚪ WONT_FIX, ❓ CANNOT_VERIFY, or plain-text equivalents).

statusRaw.description: Verbatim original status text/symbol from the source, preserved when normalization to the 'status' enum would lose nuance (e.g. 'REOPENED (partial)').

category.description: Optional free-text domain tag from the source's own 'Category' column, e.g. 'Audit Trail', 'Validation Gap', 'ISO Compliance'. Distinct from 'severity', which drives the filename/category axis.

description.description: Full narrative for this defect, transcribed faithfully from the source tracker's 'Section 1B — Defect Detail Cards' when one exists for this ID. Never summarized or invented — omitted entirely if the source has no separate narrative beyond the title.

requirement.description: ISO clause / regulatory reference, from the source's 'ISO Ref' / 'ISO/Privacy Ref' column or an inline 'violates ...' callout in the narrative.

tags.description: Free-form labels. Used to fold in CWE/OWASP classifications for Security Vulnerability defects (e.g. 'CWE-79', 'OWASP A03:2021 Injection').

component.description: Optional UI component / affected-area name, from the source's 'Component' or 'Affected Area' column.

affectedFiles.description: Optional list of 'path/to/file.ext:line' references, from the source's 'Affected Files' column or inline code references in the narrative.

fixEvidence.description: Optional description of the actual code change that fixed this defect, from the source's 'Fix Evidence' column, present only when status is fixed/regressed-then-refixed.

firstDetected.description: Date the defect was first recorded in the source tracker, if present (not always strict YYYY-MM-DD in the source).

lastVerified.description: Date of the most recent QA run that re-checked this defect, if present.

runsOpen.description: Number of consecutive QA runs this defect has been open, if the source tracks it.

sourceRun.description: Which run in the source tracker's Run History first surfaced this defect, when determinable, e.g. 'Run #1 (2026-06-11)'.

verified.description: CSV-sourced defects only (Cloud Posture) — whether the finding was independently re-confirmed by the auditor, from the CSV's one-time 'Verified' column. Distinct from 'status', which this source does not track (no OPEN/FIXED lifecycle recorded).

sourceFile.description: Provenance — repo-relative path to the QA_Tracker source this record was converted from, e.g. 'QA_Tracker/EVIDENCE_MANAGEMENT_QA_LIVE_TRACKER.md'.
